name: chromadb_vector_query
description: Runs read-only semantic similarity searches against a local persistent ChromaDB vector database. Accepts either natural-language text or a pre-computed embedding vector, supports metadata and document-content filters, and returns ranked matches with documents, metadata, raw distances and a normalised similarity score where higher is better.

query.description: Natural-language search text, embedded using the collection's own embedding function

collection.description: Name of the Chroma collection to search

db_path.description: Path to the persistent Chroma database directory

query_embedding.description: Pre-computed embedding vector. Use instead of 'query' when embeddings are generated externally; avoids loading an embedding model
